in_marathi.name: Udayraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Rising Sun, King of the Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Udayraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Uday means 'sunrise' and Raj means 'king'. Thus, Udayraj means 'Rising Sun, King of the Sun'. It is a name for a male child born during sunrise or one who is considered the king of his family and community.
